an10.13:1.3: The five lower fetters and the five higher fetters.
an10.13:1.4: And what are the five lower fetters?
an10.13:1.5: Personal-existence view, doubt, wrong grasp of behavior and observances, sensual desire, and ill will.
an10.13:1.6: These are the five lower fetters.
an10.13:2.1: And what are the five higher fetters?
an10.13:2.2: Lust for form, lust for the formless, conceit, restlessness, and ignorance.
an10.13:2.3: These are the five higher fetters.
an10.13:2.4: These, bhikkhus, are the ten fetters.”
